changes: Agent runtime/storage/tools now belong to actual node-b; its own SourceStore is empty.
The authorized remote model-a receives signed production requests and passes provider admission/outer ModelDispatchAdapter; only the wire exchange is a local fixture.
Both candidate and actual pinned reference use the same consumer tools, model policy and permission boundary.
Provider truth stays separate; no private B or third-party grants are injected into consumer observations.
Original hashes retained; relationship business comparison excludes only top-level nonces, preserving keys and all other fields.
Agent state isolation records consumer tasks/tool identity and provider AgentStore absence, while allowing provider inference-order/quota logs.
limitations: No real model, ICE, two physical hosts, or remote cancellation-delivery proof.
Consumer cannot prove provider-private B configuration or third-party grant absence; original frozen assertions remain, even if honest unknown produces failure.
